hints.title: Plate Accumulation
hints.text: Precompute prefix sums of plate occurrences up to each index.

hints.title: Nearest Boundary Markers
hints.text: For each position, store the index of the nearest candle to its left and right.

hints.title: Range Query Evaluation
hints.text: Answer each range query in constant time by identifying boundary candles.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O(N + Q) prefix precomputation and constant time queries
complexity.space: O(N) precomputed indices and prefix sums
complexity.notes: Nearest candle tables map query boundaries to interior candle positions in O(1).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning plates and candles per query takes O(N * Q) and times out.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Linear precomputation reduces range queries to instant arithmetic differences.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should precompute left and right candle indices for O(1) query time.
